opportunities.title: Regular Grant (under £100,000)

amount.raw: Regular Grant – under £100,000. Operating/core cost grants generally support around 10-20% of an organisation's total annual budget; project grants tend to be approximately 10-20% of costs; capital grants for local community projects are likely to be no greater than £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, charitable incorporated organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations under Charity Commission guidance. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts (independently audited/examined or Charity Commission annual return). Work must take place in the UK or UK Overseas Territories. Cannot fund individuals, CICs, community benefit societies, social enterprises, local authorities/councils.
opportunities.summary: Grants under £100,000 for operating/core costs, capital projects, or projects/specific activities. Open to applications all year round with no deadlines. Grants typically support 10-20% of an organisation's budget or project costs.

opportunities.title: Major Grant (£100,000 and over)

amount.raw: Major Grant – £100,000 and over. For core costs, organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over; for capital or project costs, total project cost must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, CIOs, and exempt/excepted organisations. For core cost grants, annual income must be at least £1 million. For capital or project cost grants, the total project cost must be at least £1 million (regardless of annual income). Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 and over, considered by Trustees at one of eight Board meetings per year. Applications via Expression of Interest form, open all year round with no deadlines. Expressions of Interest reviewed on a rolling basis.
